prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, channels, industry and preferred working style. I can, however, help you find the best fit. To narrow it down quickly, tell me a few things:

- Primary goal (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, app installs, SEO, content, etc.)  
- Channels you care about (PPC/Google, Facebook/Meta, LinkedIn, organic SEO, content, email, influencer, programmatic)  
- Company type and stage (startup, B2B SaaS, enterprise, DTC/e‑commerce)  
- Monthly marketing budget or annual retainer range  
- Preference for a local SF team vs. remote/national agency  
- Any must‑have capabilities (e.g., marketing automation, CRO, creative production)

If you’d like to get started right away, I can also:
- Recommend 4–6 San Francisco agencies matched to your answers with pros/cons and pricing estimates, or  
- Provide a shortlist of questions and checklist to vet agencies and run a trial project.

Which option do you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
